parametricStory.title: Art Shaped by Algorithms
parametricStory.body: Parametric design is a way of making things shaped by mathematical rules and variables. Each piece is designed on the computer so that the parameters we set produce a unique geometry — then CNC and laser cutting carry it into wood. The result is a texture where nature meets mathematics, one you won't find in mass production.

materialCraft.title: From Wood to Art
materialCraft.body: Every piece is CNC-machined from selected MDF, plywood or solid wood, then sanded and finished by hand. The number of layers, the material and the finish give each piece its character — this is studio craft, not mass production.

productFaq.question: How long does production take?
productFaq.answer: In-stock items ship within 3–5 working days. Made-to-order pieces take 2–3 weeks.

productFaq.question: Can I customise the size?
productFaq.answer: Most products can be made to a custom size of up to 50×70 cm. Choose the closest standard option and add the size you want in the order note; we'll contact you to confirm.

productFaq.question: What is your returns policy?
productFaq.answer: Items shipped from stock can be returned within 30 days in their original packaging. Made-to-order and personalised items can't be returned once production has started.

productFaq.question: Do you ship outside Türkiye?
productFaq.answer: For now we ship within Türkiye only. For international delivery, please get in touch through the contact form.

duvar-tablolari.title: Wall Art
duvar-tablolari.shortDescription: Parametric and multilayer wood art, up to 50×70 cm.
duvar-tablolari.description: Wall art with geometric and organic patterns created with parametric design software, alongside multilayer compositions with a real sense of depth. Every piece is made at up to 50×70 cm, so it can be packed securely and shipped safely.

duvar-tablolari.seoDescription: Parametric and multilayer wooden wall art up to 50×70 cm. Abstract, animal, portrait and layered designs — CNC and laser cut, packed for safe shipping.

faq.question: What are the pieces made from?
faq.answer: We work in MDF, plywood and solid wood; each product page lists the materials available.

faq.question: Why 50×70 cm at most?
faq.answer: Parametric pieces are built from thin wooden parts. Keeping to this size lets us pack every piece securely in standard boxes so it arrives undamaged.

faq.question: How does the number of layers affect the price?
faq.answer: More layers mean more material and more work, so the price goes up — the product page updates the price for the layer count you choose.

faq.question: Is the clock movement silent?
faq.answer: Yes, every clock uses a silent sweep movement.

faq.question: Can I add a name or date?
faq.answer: On the models in Personalised Clocks, send the text you want in your order note or through the "Ask About This Product" form.

faq.question: How do I choose the name and colour?

faq.question: Will the door sign be ready in time for the birth?
faq.answer: Production usually takes 3–5 working days after you approve the preview. If the due date is close, get in touch and we'll plan it together.

faq.question: Can it hang within a baby's reach?
faq.answer: No. These are decorative pieces that may contain small parts, not toys; hang them out of children's reach.
